front.title: The Compliance-Receipt HTTP Response Header Field

abstract.t: This document defines the Compliance-Receipt HTTP response header field, a Structured Field that carries a reference to a Proof of Stateful Integrity (PSI) receipt for the response. The signature covers every security-relevant parameter. The header shows that the issuer sealed a digest of the response; despite its name it does not show that the response, or the service, complies with any law or policy.
